verdict.rationale: Undermind documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.undermind.ai/mcp using Streamable HTTP and OAuth with PKCE. It gives setup instructions for Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Copilot and ChatGPT, says it works with any MCP-compatible client, and lists the research tools the server exposes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use over MCP, and non-user-scoped access (the vendor says there is no API-key or service-account model).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
